From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Neha — reproduced answers below (short, client-ready). I also attached the two artifacts I think are safe to share: IR_runbook_v2.pdf (redacted customer-facing excerpt) and SOC2-summary.xlsx (control mapping & evidence pointers). I've included the contact vCard bundle incident_contacts.vcf.

Answers (for Acme):
- Initial customer notification: We commit to communicating material customer-impacting incidents within 72 hours of confirmation of a breach affecting customer data, or sooner where legally required. For issues that may materially affect service availability but not customer data, we aim to notify within 5 business days.
- Primary escalation contacts (roles & best contact):
  * SRE Incident Lead: Hiro Tanaka — hiro_tanaka@redwood.com — primary Slack and cell (SMS) for pager alerts
  * Head of Security / IR: Laura Bennett — laura_bennett@redwood.com — email and secure voice line (available 24/7 via on-call rotation)
  * Legal / Privacy Counsel (external-facing contact): external.legal@redwood.com — email; will engage within 2 hours for incidents with legal/regulatory implications
- Notification workflow (summary): detection -> triage -> confirm scope & affected customers -> engage legal/PR -> notify affected customers + remedial steps -> post‑incident report. See attached IR_runbook_v2.pdf excerpt.

Please note: 72 hours is our customer-facing target post-confirmation; detection-to-confirmation timelines vary by incident complexity. We include escalation SLAs internally (30 min ack, 3 hours initial triage) but typically do not publish internal ack times in SIG answers.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
